title: Joint Stars synthetic aperture radar proven in Desert Storm

tellings.quote: This one shows, hey, we did this in Desert Storm. And uh after Joint Stars was demonstrated in Desert Storm, we decided we will never go into combat without the synthetic aperture radar that was developed by uh Joystars.

plain: A system called Joint Stars, an airborne radar developed in the 1980s, proved itself in the Gulf War known as Desert Storm, according to Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor who says he was there for its development. Its key tool was synthetic aperture radar, a radar that builds detailed pictures of the ground from the air. Rogers tells Michels that after the Desert Storm demonstration, 'we decided we will never go into combat without' it.
